reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: six-metre-wide low-gradient landscape teaching patch. One continuous surface carries a shallow winding main runnel and three connected tributaries merging downhill toward the front outlet; channel depth is actual geometry, and the muted darker mud palette is not a water simulation. Original nominal spacing, slope, crop thickness and colors; not a complete shoreline survey, a measured prehistoric terrain, or a hand-scale rock. Original scale_class landscape and coast biome preserved.
